newsitem.title: USA: New York State Thruway Board approves 1997 budget.
newsitem.headline: New York State Thruway Board approves 1997 budget.

text.p: The Board of the New York State Thruway Authority said it approved a $191 million operating budget for 1997, roughly $14 million , or 7.3 percent, less that previous projections.
"We've reduced spending and are operating more efficiently without compromising safety," said Chairman Howard Steinberg.
The 1997 projections were based on operating costs, inflation and personnel expenses. The 1997 budget is also $3.8 million less than the 1996 budget plan.
Some operating savings were acheived through job reductions. Nearly 300 Thruway and Canal positions have been eliminated and 250 jobs have been left unfilled.
The authority's 1997 capital program has not been finalized, but will be completed by the end of the year, Steinberg said.
